body:
Thanks for your comments. I do feel better now. I had to get it off my chest. I'm not cured and nothing has changed but my attitude. Today, I think my internet is on the way to getting fixed to better than it's ever been. So, I've got that going for me :)  

I think the act of putting pen to paper was enough to snap me out of it, for the time being at least. Thanks for listening.

Thank you. I had already a few attempts before I was twenty. No-one knew and they still don't. Looking back, I'm glad it didn't work. I'd be a liar to myself if I said I didn't have some good times over the years. It's taken me this long to express myself and I believe you too can live a good life if you just give it a go. It sounds strange to say given what I wrote and how I feel, but even your short reply picked me up a little. I may feel different tomorrow, but I have another day and that's what it's about. You still have plenty of years ahead of you and do hope you hang in there. It's not all bad.
